enriched_activities.desc: Lie on back. Close eyes. Breathe deeply. Turn to left side. Bend knees. Pull blanket up. Turn to right side. Stretch arms. Adjust pillow. Lie still. Move legs under blanket. Turn head. Exhale. Inhale. Continue sleeping.
Wake up. Sit up. Stand. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Use toilet. Flush. Turn on tap. Wash hands. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wipe face.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out milk and eggs. Close refrigerator. Take out bowl and pan from cabinet. Crack eggs into bowl. Whisk eggs. Turn on induction cooker. Pour eggs into pan. Cook eggs. Transfer eggs to plate. Eat breakfast.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Close wardrobe. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Comb hair. Pack bag.

Walk to car. Unlock car. Open car door. Sit in driver's seat. Close door. Fasten seatbelt. Insert key. Turn key. Press accelerator. Steer wheel. Stop at traffic light. Wait. Press accelerator. Park car. Turn off engine. Unfasten seatbelt. Open door. Step out. Close door. Lock car.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Enter hospital. Greet colleague. Put on scrubs. Wash hands. Review patient charts. Enter patient room. Examine patient. Take vital signs. Administer medication. Update records. Consult with doctor. Attend meeting. Eat lunch. Wash hands. See more patients. Write prescriptions. Use computer. Answer phone. Discuss with nurse. Leave hospital.

Walk to car. Unlock car. Open car door. Sit in driver's seat. Close door. Fasten seatbelt. Insert key. Turn key. Press accelerator. Steer wheel. Stop at traffic light. Wait. Press accelerator. Park car. Turn off engine. Unfasten seatbelt. Open door. Step out. Close door. Lock car.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and meat. Close refrigerator. Take out cutting board and knife. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Cut meat. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan on cooker. Pour oil into pan. Add meat. Stir meat. Add vegetables. Stir vegetables. Turn off cooker. Transfer food to plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner.

Stand up from table. Pick up plates. Scrape food into trash. Stack plates. Open dishwasher. Load plates into dishwasher. Load utensils. Close dishwasher. Turn on dishwasher. Pick up pots. Wash pots in sink. Rinse pots. Place pots on drying rack. Wipe counter with cloth. Wipe table.

Walk to living room. Sit on couch. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Browse channels. Select movie. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out drink. Close refrigerator. Walk back to living room. Sit on couch. Drink. Put drink on table. Pick up phone. Check phone. Continue watching TV.
Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Undress. Step into shower. Turn on shower. Wash body. Shampoo hair. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Dry with towel. Put on pajamas.
Lie on bed. Pull blanket up. Close eyes. Breathe deeply. Turn to side. Adjust pillow. Lie still. Move legs. Turn head. Exhale. Inhale. Continue sleeping.
